events.text: Hi, I got the wrong dish in my order tonight. I ordered tofu pho from Pho Real but what arrived is a different noodle dish, and I'm not sure how that happened.
I'm sorry about that. I can look into it. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account.
Sure. My full name is Omar Haddad, and the email on the account is omar.haddad@post.example.

events.text:
Thanks, Omar, you're verified. I can see order O-5110, delivered tonight at 6:47 PM. The tofu pho ($13.50) is the item affected. You have two options:

1. **Refund** of $13.50 to your Visa ending in 4242.
2. **Account credit** of $16.20 (the item price plus 20%) to use on a future order.

Which would you prefer? Also, did the spring rolls arrive correctly?
Thanks, Omar. I'd prefer the refund to my card, please. And yes, the spring rolls were fine, it was just the noodle dish that was wrong.
I've refunded $13.50 for the tofu pho to your Visa ending in 4242. It should arrive in 3–5 business days. I'm sorry about the mix-up, Omar. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thanks for sorting the refund. There's one more thing I should mention. The noodle dish I got had peanut sauce on it, and I have a peanut allergy. I took two bites before I noticed, and my throat got itchy. I took an antihistamine and I feel fine now, so I don't need medical help at the moment. But I'd like someone to look into how a peanut dish ended up in a tofu order, since that could hurt someone who doesn't catch it in time.

args.summary: Customer Omar Haddad ordered tofu pho from Pho Real (order O-5110) but received a different noodle dish with peanut sauce. He has a peanut allergy, ate two bites, had an itchy throat, took an antihistamine and reports feeling fine now. Wrong-item refund of $13.50 already issued (RF-4001). He asks that the restaurant/order mix-up be investigated so it doesn't harm others.

events.text:
I'm glad you're feeling okay, Omar, and I'm sorry this happened. I've sent your report to a human specialist as a food-safety case, with the order details. I included the peanut sauce, your allergic reaction, and your request to look into how the mix-up happened. They will follow up with you within 24 hours.

If your symptoms come back or get worse, please get medical help right away. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thanks, that helps. I'll keep an eye on my throat and call for help if anything comes back or gets worse. I'll wait to hear from the specialist within 24 hours. That's all I need for now.
You're welcome, Omar. Take care, and I hope you feel better. Goodbye!
